description: Gives any Earth coordinate a stable identity: its ~19 m world tile (Web Mercator zoom 21, the Anagramic globe grid), tile bounds and centre, and the deterministic ROAST-78 card that tile holds (Roast-78 character, card, keyword, upright/reversed, element, rune, hieroglyph, I Ching hexagram, math and navigation symbols), plus the eight neighbouring tiles. The same coordinate always returns the same identity, so agents can anchor games, stories, AR scenes and shared worlds to real places. Includes a replayable receipt hash. Price: $0.01 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

includeNeighbours.description: Optional. Include the eight surrounding tiles (default true).

latitude.description: Latitude from -90 to 90 (Web Mercator clamps beyond ±85.05).

name: spatial_identity
title: Spatial identity (ROAST-78 world tile)
